permissions.comment: Renders are opened from disk, in whatever player handles MP4. The app data directory is the only place they live; nothing else is reachable.

The backend port is reserved at startup and differs every run, so the loopback entry has to admit any port - a fixed http://127.0.0.1/* matched nothing and every Open video failed. Loopback is the only entry: nothing in the UI opens an external link, and a blanket https://* handed a compromised webview a one-call exfiltration path. Adding external links later means listing their domains, not restoring the wildcard.
